en.headline: Worker injured after falling from truck while unloading goods in Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 52-year-old man was taken conscious to North District Hospital after falling about one metre from a medium-sized truck early on Wednesday.
body: A 52-year-old man surnamed Yeung was injured after falling from a medium-sized truck while unloading goods in Sheung Shui early on Wednesday.
The incident happened around 2am on On Lok Mun Street. Rescuers found him conscious and took him to North District Hospital.
Initial investigations suggest he fell about one metre from the truck while moving goods. The case has been classified as an industrial accident with a person injured.

zh.headline: 上水工人搬貨時從貨車墮下受傷
zh.dek: 52歲姓楊男子周三凌晨約2時在安樂門街從中型貨車墮下約一米，清醒送往北區醫院治理，案件列作工業意外。
body: 上水一名52歲姓楊男子周三凌晨在搬貨時從中型貨車墮下受傷。
事發於安樂門街約凌晨2時，救援人員到場時傷者清醒，並將他送往北區醫院。
初步調查顯示，他在搬運貨物時從貨車墮下約一米。警方將案件列作工業意外有人受傷跟進。
